metadata.question: Does the plume from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand travel in a southern direction on January 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand (~-37.52°S, 177.18°E) - Date: January 7, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for visible imagery to detect volcanic plume, or MODIS for aerosol/thermal detection - Need high temporal resolution for specific day 2. Masking strategy: - DO NOT mask clouds - we're looking FOR a plume which may appear cloud-like - Need to visually assess plume direction using aerosol optical depth or true color composite - The plume itself is the phenomenon of interest 3. Logic: - Valid observation (A/B): Images exist, can determine plume direction - C1: No images for Jan 7, 2025 - C2: Images exist but area is completely obscured - C3: Cannot determine direction due to data quality - Southern direction means plume extends toward higher latitude (more negative, toward -38°S or beyond) 4. Approach: - Use Sentinel-2 L2A for true color or Sentinel-5P for aerosol index - Check if plume is visible and extends southward from volcano location - Use aerosol index or SO2 column to detect plume ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.52]) roi = volcano_point.buffer(50000) # 50km buffer to capture plume date_start = '2025-01-07' date_end = '2025-01-08' print(f"Analyzing plume from Whakaari/White Island on {date_start}") # 2. Try Sentinel-5P for SO2 and aerosol detection (better for gas plumes) s5p_so2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(roi) s5p_ai = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(roi) print(f"Sentinel-5P SO2 images: {s5p_so2.size().getInfo()}") print(f"Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index images: {s5p_ai.size().getInfo()}") # 3. Try Sentinel-2 as backup for visual plume s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(roi) print(f"Sentinel-2 images: {s2.size().getInfo()}") # Check if any data exists if s5p_so2.size().getInfo() == 0 and s5p_ai.size().getInfo() == 0 and s2.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No satellite data available for January 7, 2025") print("C1") else: # Analyze SO2 or Aerosol Index distribution if s5p_ai.size().getInfo() > 0: ai_img = s5p_ai.first() # Define north and south regions relative to volcano north_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([177.0, -37.52, 177.4, -37.2]) # North of volcano south_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([177.0, -37.8, 177.4, -37.52]) # South of volcano # Calculate mean aerosol index in both regions north_stats = ai_img.select('absorbing_aerosol_index').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=north_region, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) south_stats = ai_img.select('absorbing_aerosol_index').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=south_region, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) north_ai = north_stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo() south_ai = south_stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo() print(f"North region Aerosol Index: {north_ai}") print(f"South region Aerosol Index: {south_ai}") if north_ai is None or south_ai is None: print("Cannot determine plume direction - insufficient data quality") print("C3") elif south_ai > north_ai and south_ai > 1.0: print("Plume detected traveling southward (higher aerosol index in south)") print("A") else: print("Plume not traveling primarily southward") print("B") else: print("Insufficient aerosol data to determine plume direction") print("C2") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.52])
roi = volcano_point.buffer(50000)  # 50km buffer to capture plume
date_start = '2025-01-07'
date_end = '2025-01-08'

print(f"Analyzing plume from Whakaari/White Island on {date_start}")

# 2. Try Sentinel-5P for SO2 and aerosol detection (better for gas plumes)
s5p_so2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(roi)

s5p_ai = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(roi)

print(f"Sentinel-5P SO2 images: {s5p_so2.size().getInfo()}")
print(f"Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index images: {s5p_ai.size().getInfo()}")

# 3. Try Sentinel-2 as backup for visual plume
s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(roi)

print(f"Sentinel-2 images: {s2.size().getInfo()}")

# Check if any data exists
if s5p_so2.size().getInfo() == 0 and s5p_ai.size().getInfo() == 0 and s2.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No satellite data available for January 7, 2025")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Analyze SO2 or Aerosol Index distribution
    if s5p_ai.size().getInfo() > 0:
        ai_img = s5p_ai.first()
        
        # Define north and south regions relative to volcano
        north_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([177.0, -37.52, 177.4, -37.2])  # North of volcano
        south_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([177.0, -37.8, 177.4, -37.52])  # South of volcano
        
        # Calculate mean aerosol index in both regions
        north_stats = ai_img.select('absorbing_aerosol_index').reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=north_region,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        
        south_stats = ai_img.select('absorbing_aerosol_index').reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=south_region,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        
        north_ai = north_stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo()
        south_ai = south_stats.get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo()
        
        print(f"North region Aerosol Index: {north_ai}")
        print(f"South region Aerosol Index: {south_ai}")
        
        if north_ai is None or south_ai is None:
            print("Cannot determine plume direction - insufficient data quality")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif south_ai > north_ai and south_ai > 1.0:
            print("Plume detected traveling southward (higher aerosol index in south)")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Plume not traveling primarily southward")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
    else:
        print("Insufficient aerosol data to determine plume direction")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
